title: MidiClip
description: MIDI clip + note payloads: arguments/results of midi_add_clip, midi_set_notes, midi_get_clips (Rust mirror: src-tauri/src/midi/types.rs). ALL musical positions are integer ticks at the project PPQ (debt D-02: never seconds, never samples). On the IPC surface notes travel as JSON arrays on the clip; in project.json notes are persisted as AMEV binary chunks. v2 persists one conflated row per clip ($defs/persistedClipLegacy); from schemaVersion 3 (ADR 0004, round-2 §5, transcribed from src-tauri/src/midi/persist.rs:178-233) that row is split across three project.json arrays — $defs/persistedContentRow (content[]), $defs/persistedPlacementRow (placements[]), $defs/persistedLaneRow (lanes[]) — see project-v3.schema.json. Emitter contract — no additionalProperties:false (D-06).

tick.description: Onset, ticks relative to clip start.

noteId.description: Stable per-clip note identity (round-2 §2.1). 0 = unassigned (wire sentinel); every note inside the document has id >= 1, minted from its clip's persisted watermark and never reused (ADR 0001). Additive (D-06).

clip.title: MidiClip (IPC)
clip.description: In-memory/IPC form: notes inline, sorted by (tick, key).

contentLengthTicks.description: Content (loop/native) length in ticks — ADR 0004's content half of the placement/content split; lengthTicks stays the placement length. Absent means "same as lengthTicks" (pre-looping semantics). When lengthTicks > contentLengthTicks the content repeats to fill the placement; when shorter, content is cropped. Additive (D-06).

transposeSemitones.description: Placement transpose in semitones (Plan F Task 12; round-2 §5). Applied at schedule/bounce time; note CONTENT is never rewritten. Absent/0 = none. Additive (D-06).

velocityOffset.description: Placement velocity offset (Plan F Task 12). Added to each note at schedule time, result clamped to 1..=127. Stored notes stay as written. Absent/0 = none. Additive (D-06).

persistedClipLegacy.title: MidiClip (project.json v2, superseded)
persistedClipLegacy.description: v2's single conflated row per clip: notes live in an AMEV chunk file (16-byte records; layout in src-tauri/src/midi/events.rs), referenced relative to the .aura dir. SUPERSEDED at schemaVersion 3 by the persistedContentRow/persistedPlacementRow/persistedLaneRow split below (ADR 0004) — persist.rs stops WRITING this shape from v3 on (`obj.remove("midiClips")` on every v3 save) but still READS it forever (src-tauri/src/midi/persist.rs::parse_clips_legacy), so an un-resaved v2 project keeps loading correctly.

contentLengthTicks.description: Content (loop/native) length in ticks — ADR 0004's content half of the placement/content split; lengthTicks stays the placement length. Absent means "same as lengthTicks" (pre-looping semantics). When lengthTicks > contentLengthTicks the content repeats to fill the placement; when shorter, content is cropped. Additive (D-06).

eventsRef.description: Relative path of the AMEV chunk, e.g. "events/<clipId>.bin". Chunks are immutable-once-written; edits write a new chunk under a new UUID (SCALABILITY §4).

patternId.description: RESERVED for the pattern/playlist milestone (SCALABILITY §3): when set, this clip is an instance of a shared pattern and eventsRef is absent.

nextNoteId.description: Persisted note-id watermark (round-2 §2.1, C-1): the durable authority for the clip's next-minted note id — written unconditionally (even for an emptied clip, which writes no eventsRef) so the watermark survives independently of the AMEV chunk. Loaded as max(row, chunk). Additive (D-06).

transposeSemitones.description: Placement transpose in semitones (Plan F Task 12). Written only when nonzero so an old project resaves byte-diff-free. Additive (D-06).

velocityOffset.description: Placement velocity offset (Plan F Task 12). Written only when nonzero. Additive (D-06).

persistedContentRow.title: MidiClip content row (project.json v3, content[])
persistedContentRow.description: ADR 0004 note-payload half of the v3 content/placement split (round-2 §5), transcribed from persist.rs:196-215 (`save_snapshot_into_project`). One row per MIDI clip; joined to its placement row via the placement's contentId.

kind.description: Every content row this codebase writes today is "midi"; read but not yet branched on (a future audio-content-array round would add "audio" rows here).

nextNoteId.description: Persisted note-id watermark (round-2 §2.1, C-1) — MOVED here from the v2 placement row: the durable authority for the clip's next-minted note id, written unconditionally even for an emptied clip. Loaded as max(row, chunk).

contentLengthTicks.description: Content (loop/native) length in ticks (ADR 0004). Only written when Some, so a never-looped project resaves byte-diff-free. Absent means "same as the placement's lengthTicks".

eventsRef.description: Relative path of the AMEV chunk, e.g. "events/<uuid>.bin". Only written when the clip has at least one note; absent for an empty clip. Chunks are immutable-once-written; edits write a new chunk under a new UUID (SCALABILITY §4).

persistedPlacementRow.title: MidiClip placement row (project.json v3, placements[])
persistedPlacementRow.description: ADR 0004 position/identity half of the v3 content/placement split (round-2 §5), transcribed from persist.rs:216-223. One row per MIDI clip; resolves to a track through laneId -> lanes[] (persistedLaneRow), not directly.

transposeSemitones.description: Placement transpose in semitones (Plan F Task 12; round-2 §5 placement table). Written only when nonzero so a never-transposed project resaves byte-diff-free. Additive (D-06).

velocityOffset.description: Placement velocity offset (Plan F Task 12). Written only when nonzero. Additive (D-06).

persistedLaneRow.title: MidiClip lane row (project.json v3, lanes[])
persistedLaneRow.description: Resolves a laneId to its trackId (persist.rs:224-234). One row per DISTINCT lane actually referenced by a placement — today that's one per track-with-a-clip (every clip on a track shares that track's default lane, `LaneId::default_for_track`). A track with zero clips gets no lane row.
